name: Long Wash
summary: Along Darkshore, Long Wash runs south from Auberdine toward Ameth'Aran beneath a gray sky. Murlocs now make its shore dangerous.

sections.title: A Gloomy Shoreline
sections.body: Long Wash is Darkshore's shortest distinct stretch of coast, despite its name. Beneath the region's perpetual overcast skies, damp sand lies strewn with flotsam, driftwood, and sea creatures washed up by the Veiled Sea. Crabs comb the surf, but travelers heading south from Auberdine must watch for murloc tribes camped along the water's edge. The murlocs attack anyone who enters the territory where they scavenge.

faq.q: Where is the Long Wash located?
faq.answer: Long Wash follows Darkshore's coast just south of Auberdine and reaches roughly west of the ruins of Ameth'Aran.

faq.q: Why is it called the Long Wash?
faq.answer: A wash is an old word for a stretch of shore swept by ocean waves. Though called Long Wash, it is Darkshore's shortest distinct beach.

faq.q: What threats can be found along the Long Wash?
faq.answer: Aggressive murloc clans gather along Long Wash, alongside territorial tide crawlers and other beach wildlife.

faq.q: Why are there so many dead creatures on the beach?
faq.answer: The rough surf of the Veiled Sea washes debris, ship drift, and dying marine life onto Long Wash's damp sands. Corruption is also encroaching on Darkshore's coastal waters.

angles.text: For the kaldorei of Auberdine, the murlocs along Long Wash are another sign of an unsettling imbalance creeping right up to their main port's doorstep.
